_comment: The marketplace index. Every entry is display metadata plus a GitHub link —
installing one resolves that link through the ordinary installer, with the
ordinary consent prompt. There is no server that decides what may be
installed, and nothing you cannot read before you run it.
This copy ships in the wheel so `lesysbot search` works offline. The
published copy at https://lesysbot.github.io/catalog.json is refreshed by
`lesysbot search --refresh`; tests/test_catalog.py keeps the two in step.
